outcome_sought: Stop the legal action letters, agree an affordable payment plan, remove the two £45 arrears fees and explain why nobody called back.
rationale: He asked for a payment plan before falling far behind, the callback was never made and collections sent two legal-action letters with no hold in place, so CP-9.1 (forbearance, pausing collections, debt advice) is central and the fees fall under CP-9.2. Mortgage arrears belong with Mortgage Servicing. The only contact on file is his own call in September, and nobody has tried to reach him since the complaint arrived.
